newsitem.title: GERMANY: Malta plane hijacked to Germany - police.
newsitem.headline: Malta plane hijacked to Germany - police.

text.p: An Air Malta plane with 85 people on board appeared to have been hijacked to Germany early on Monday on a flight from Malta to Istanbul, German police said.
The Boeing 737 airliner landed unexpectedly at Cologne-Bonn airport at 4.47 a.m. (0247 GMT) and was standing on the runway, a police spokesman at the airport told Reuters.
"It is highly probable that we are dealing with a hijacking," the police spokesman said.
The hijacker might be a Turkish speaker, he said, as a Turkish interpreter had been called to the airport.
He said 79 adults, one child and five crew members were on board the plane, which had been headed for Istanbul from Malta.
